aboutGame.title: What is Course to Venus?
paragraphs: Course to Venus is a humorous near-future sci-fi adventure from developer Not Every Witch. You plan and fly a craft from Earth toward Venus, balancing propulsion and fuel against heat, shielding, supplies, and crew condition while events and hazards resolve every round.

The game blends route planning, puzzles, and character relationships: open sealed vents, track down keys and tools like the crowbar, search the ship deck by deck, and follow branching choices with Molly, Jenna, and the ghost. Our Course to Venus wiki gathers the walkthroughs, item locations, character guides, and progression tips you need.

modules.name: Course to Venus Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step Course to Venus beginner guide covering how a run plays out, fuel and heat management, route planning, and the early mistakes that end a launch.

highlights.detail: Read the route map before you move and pick a single primary goal for the run.
Choose a forgiving mode such as Standard for your first genuine Course to Venus run.
Plot your maneuver, then commit fuel, actions, or cards while always keeping a reserve.
Resolve hazards, heat, and events by reading the full result before you react.
Manage repairs, cooling, resupply, and crew rotation the same round a problem appears.
Track progress toward your objective and bank fuel for the final arrival burn.

modules.name: Course to Venus Walkthrough
modules.description: An act-by-act Course to Venus walkthrough covering branch points, puzzle strategies, collectibles, endings, and the save habits that keep every route recoverable.

highlights.detail: Rotate at least three save slots so a wrong branch never becomes permanent.
Explore everything in an area and clear optional content before advancing the story.
Save in a fresh slot before any confirmation prompt or chapter transition.
Solve pattern and sequence puzzles by changing one variable at a time.
Log every major decision and unresolved thread to speed up alternate endings.
Backtrack immediately when a collectible category looks incomplete at the end of a stage.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Course to Venus.

items.question: What is Course to Venus?
items.answer: Course to Venus is a humorous near-future sci-fi adventure from developer Not Every Witch. You plan a journey from Earth toward Venus, balancing fuel, heat, and supplies while events, puzzles, and character choices resolve along the way.

items.question: What platforms can I play Course to Venus on?
items.answer: The official itch.io page lists HTML5, Windows, and Android, so you can play Course to Venus in a browser or on desktop and mobile.

items.question: Is there a Course to Venus walkthrough?
items.answer: Yes. Our Course to Venus walkthrough breaks the journey into acts, flags branch points and points of no return, and covers puzzles, collectibles, and endings.

items.question: How do I open the vent in Course to Venus?
items.answer: Learn the interaction prompts and timing in our Course to Venus vent controls guide, then match the correct keybind on your platform to open the vent without wasting a round.

items.question: Who are the main characters in Course to Venus?
items.answer: Molly, Jenna, and the ghost anchor the story. Our Course to Venus characters guide covers their roles, relationship routes, and the choices that unlock extra scenes.

items.question: Does Course to Venus have codes?
items.answer: Course to Venus uses a phone code system rather than a standard redeem-code list. Our Course to Venus phone code guide explains where working codes appear and how to redeem them step by step.

items.question: How often is Course to Venus updated?
items.answer: Course to Venus updates land roughly once a month, with the public version currently at 0.5.3 and version 0.6 in development.
